message.content:
The product is a testing apparatus for mid-drive units that measures torque, speed, power, voltage, current and temperature. The likely candidates are in heading 9031 (measuring or checking instruments, appliances and machines) and heading 9024 (machines for testing mechanical properties of materials).

Heading 9024 covers testing of hardness, tensile strength, compressibility and elasticity of materials, so it does not fit a motor dynamometer. Heading 9031 covers machines for measuring or checking mechanical quantities, and the HTS lists "Other instruments, appliances and machines" under 9031.80. Engine and motor test benches are generally classified in 9031.

Within 9031, 9031.80 is the group for other instruments, appliances and machines. Subheading 9031.80.80 is "Other" (electrical or non-optical), and its statistical suffix is 9031.80.8085 for other items. 9031.80.40 covers "Other optical instruments", which does not apply here. The 9031.80.80 line is split into 9031.80.8038 for electrical instruments for measuring or checking, other, and 9031.80.8085 for the rest. I am not certain of those suffixes and chose the general "other" one.

Since the apparatus is a test bench for mechanical and electrical quantities, I classify it under 9031.80.8085.

{"hts_code": "9031.80.8085", "reason": "The dynamometer is a test bench that measures torque, speed, power and other quantities of motors, so it falls under heading 9031 as an other measuring or checking machine, subheading 9031.80.80."}
